refill.why: Not needed: B04 and B02 fill the two BUILD slots, and B02 already contains this phrase.
The Korean fragment 그게 작동한다고 has no clear ending, and 그게 could also be ei fod o'n gweithio, so there are two Welsh answers.
Only one USE slot is needed. 그게 also leaves hynna versus ei fod o open.
Only one USE slot is needed. 그게 also leaves hynna versus ei fod o open.
작동하는지 means 'whether it works', but the Welsh says bod ('that it works'). 그게 also leaves hynna versus ei fod o open.
Only one USE slot is needed. Also, 정말 does not clearly fix mor, and the 작동해서 ('because it works') clause is loose against bod.
